item.description:
A new standing stretch break — with a figure that shows the movement.

New

  • Standing stretch break: shoulders, chest and neck, guided by a figure inside the ring
  • Optionally with calf raises as a fourth movement — switchable in settings
  • The recovery break now opens guided; after that the screen goes quiet
  • In the final minute you can start the break early instead of waiting out the countdown

Improved

  • The eye movement is no longer on by default — there is no research behind it, while stretching and breathing are supported. It stays available in settings
  • The continuous-focus limit is now 75 minutes instead of 50, unless you have moved the slider yourself
  • Among the long breaks, the screen-free one is now marked as the recommendation

Fixed

  • Cancelling an exercise with ESC left its tones playing
